ai.title: AI assistance
ai.description: Optional AI help over your mail, powered by a provider you configure — including a fully local Ollama endpoint. Mail never depends on AI.
ai.enableHint: Off by default. With AI off, no AI affordances appear anywhere in the app and nothing is ever sent to a provider.
ai.offHint: Turn AI assistance on to configure a provider, test the connection, and choose which surfaces may use it.
ai.keysFinePrint: Provider API keys are encrypted at rest on this machine and are never included in exported data — exports contain mailbox content only. Ollama runs entirely locally.

modelPlaceholders.custom: any model id the endpoint serves

surfaces.title: AI surfaces
surfaces.description: Each surface can be turned off individually. Surfaces only send content you explicitly invoke them on, and only to the active provider.

summaries.label: Thread summaries
summaries.description: Summarize an open thread on request.

smartReplies.label: Smart replies
smartReplies.description: Draft reply suggestions that match your writing style.

composeTransform.label: Compose transforms
composeTransform.description: Improve, shorten, or formalize selected draft text.

askInbox.label: Ask My Inbox
askInbox.description: Translate natural-language questions into mailbox searches.

categorizationAssist.label: Categorization assist (opt-in)
categorizationAssist.description: Let the provider classify messages the rule engine cannot. Off by default.

quickReplies.label: Quick replies
quickReplies.description: Offer short one-tap reply chips under an open message. Nothing sends automatically.

ruleAssist.label: Natural-language rules
ruleAssist.description: Translate a typed rule description into a rule preview. Only your description is sent.

eventExtraction.label: Event extraction
eventExtraction.description: Suggest calendar events from open threads. Accepting one opens the event form prefilled — nothing is saved until you do.

translation.label: Translate
translation.description: Translate a message into your output language on request. Only that message's text is sent.

folderDigest.label: Catch-me-up digest
folderDigest.description: Summarize the unread threads of the folder you invoke it in. Only threads from that folder are sent.

assistant.label: AI assistant
assistant.description: Chat with your mailbox: ask questions and the assistant looks threads up read-only to answer. Nothing is changed by it.

voiceProfile.label: Writing voice learning
voiceProfile.description: The one-call action that learns your writing voice from sent mail for dictation-adjacent drafting. Runs only when you click Learn.

tiers.title: Model tiers
tiers.description: Each surface runs on one of three tiers. Set a model id per tier for the active provider; a tier left empty uses the provider's default model.
tiers.outputLanguagePlaceholder: e.g. German — leave empty to infer from the input
tiers.outputLanguageHint: Generative surfaces answer in this language when set; left empty, the language follows the conversation.

providers.title: Providers
providers.description: Add a provider, test the connection, then mark one active. Model ids are free text — type whatever your provider offers.
providers.empty: No providers configured yet. Until one is active, no AI affordances appear anywhere in the app.

dialog.description: Your key is encrypted on this machine and is sent only to the provider you configured, per request.
dialog.name: Name
dialog.ollamaHint: Ollama runs on this machine — requests never leave your computer and no API key is needed.
dialog.apiKeySaved: Saved — leave blank to keep the stored key
dialog.apiKeyPlaceholder: Paste your key (stored encrypted on this machine)

cache.title: Cached AI results
cache.description: AI results are cached on this machine, keyed by input content and model, and reused when the same input repeats. Removing an account automatically deletes the results derived from its mail.

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: Requests and token totals per surface, recorded on this machine. Cached results are reused without a request and are not counted.

writingStyle.title: Writing style
writingStyle.description: Smart replies follow your writing style. Building the profile analyzes your recent sent messages with the active provider — suggestions are always editable drafts; nothing is ever sent automatically.
writingStyle.noAccount: No active account — the profile is built per account from its sent mail.

failures.noSentMail: No recent sent messages were found to analyze.
failures.parse: The writing style could not be read from the model's reply. Try again.

semanticSearch.title: Semantic search
semanticSearch.description: Let the assistant also find threads by MEANING, not just exact words. Runs entirely on this machine: a {{size}} language model is downloaded once from Hugging Face and your mail is never sent anywhere by it.
semanticSearch.downloadFailed: The model download failed ({{error}}). You can retry.
semanticSearch.downloadCancelled: Download cancelled — semantic search stays off until the model is downloaded.
semanticSearch.spill_one: This mailbox holds more than the in-memory limit — the {{formatted}} oldest thread is not part of semantic results.
semanticSearch.spill_other: This mailbox holds more than the in-memory limit — the {{formatted}} oldest threads are not part of semantic results.

pgp.title: Encryption
pgp.description: OpenPGP signing and encryption. Keys are generated and stored on this machine only.
pgp.noAccount: Add an account to manage its encryption keys.
pgp.enableHint: Per account: {{email}}. Turning it on reveals the key tools below; signing and encrypting stay per-message choices in the composer.

manager.description: Keys sign and decrypt this account's mail. They never leave this machine; share only the public key.
manager.noKeys: No keys yet. Generate a key pair to start signing and encrypting, or import an existing private key.
manager.noPublicKeys: No public keys imported yet. Import a correspondent's public key to encrypt mail to them.
manager.footer: Signing and encrypting are chosen per message in the composer; the recipient lookup uses the public keys listed here.
manager.materialMissing: The public key material is missing.
manager.copiedFor: Public key for {{email}} copied to the clipboard
manager.copiedForThisKey: Public key for this key copied to the clipboard
manager.copyFailed: Could not copy the public key.
manager.setDefaultFailed: Could not set the default key.

generate.title: Generate Key Pair
generate.description: Creates an OpenPGP key pair for this account, protected by the passphrase and stored encrypted on this machine.
generate.name: Name
generate.passphraseHint: Required. Without it the private key cannot be used or recovered — there is no way to reset it.
generate.failed: Could not generate the key pair.
generate.saveDescription: The key pair for {{email}} was generated. Share the public key with your correspondents so they can encrypt to you and verify your signatures.
generate.recoveryWarning: The private key cannot be recovered without its passphrase — if you lose it, the key and every message encrypted to it become unreadable. There is no server-side backup; keep a copy of this key pair somewhere safe before continuing.
generate.copied: Public key copied to the clipboard
generate.exportFailed: Could not export the public key.

import.title: Import Key
import.description: Paste an armored OpenPGP key or load it from a file. A private key is re-protected with the passphrase you give here — it must be the key's existing passphrase when the key already has one.
import.loadFromFile: Load armored key from a file
import.passphraseHint: Validated against the key before anything is stored — keys are never saved without a passphrase you have proven.
import.importedPrivate: Private key imported and protected with your passphrase
import.readFileFailed: Could not read the selected file.

delete.descriptionPrivate: Delete the private key for {{label}}? Messages encrypted to it can no longer be decrypted and it can no longer sign mail. This cannot be undone.
delete.descriptionPublic: Delete the public key for {{label}}? You will no longer be able to encrypt mail to {{label}} with this key. This cannot be undone.
